chapter.title: Crossroads
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the three PowerPyx 100% charts (332 nodes: Kara 101, Markus 108, Connor 123; 30 endings: 11, 10, 9) and the game’s text (the 30.1 Kara, 30.2 Connor and 30.3 Markus templates and the shared intro, resolved against the string table). Intercut as in the game: the drive, Ferndale, the arrival, Connor’s exploration, Alice’s secret, the captain’s cabin (or North’s), Connor’s confrontation with Markus or North (the deviancy choice), then the raid if Connor located Jericho: Kara’s corridor, crossroad, cabin and breach; Markus’s corridors, Josh, the control room and the escape with North; machine Connor’s cargo hall and the gun QTE, or deviant Connor’s takeover. About 60 relationship and instability arrows from the template; no probability anywhere (every QTE and navigation failure is an unsourced risk); no public opinion change. Researched in docs/research/chapters/ch30-crossroads.md. Review: the North-led council is a scripted observer event (M21-north); rebuilt chapter exports take priority over legacy inputs, and chapter 31 receives ch30NorthWounded/ch30MarkusDied/ch30JerichoBlown aliases.
